paragraphs: The E-Pace P200 has been part of the E-Pace range since the model launched in 2017. The P200 uses the AJ200 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine from Jaguar Land Rover's Ingenium family. It sits as the entry-level petrol option in the E-Pace line-up, positioned below the discontinued P250 and alongside the D165 and D200 diesel variants and the P300e plug-in hybrid. Jaguar E-Pace P200 Engine Compatibility The E-Pace P200 uses the AJ200 petrol engine across its entire production run. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the E-Pace P200 from 2023 to present. The AJ200 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ200 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ200 rebuild.
